title: Unmatched native test filter reports all tests passed with no execution
summary: A temporary harness including the unchanged header registered one failing case. Unfiltered invocation exits 1; INDIGO_TEST_CASE_FILTER=misspelled-case executes none, prints all tests passed and exits 0. Direct binaries/Makefile targets can falsely appear green. run_driver_test.py already rejects filtered recording. Preserve cross-suite filtering with explicit skips and an aggregate no-tests failure.

resolution.evidence: 20261101200402-daf2-fix-audit-test-verdicts/verification.md, security.md and quality-review.md: original characterization, scoped fix, full applicable regressions and independent review passed with documented platform/dependency limits.
